description: Django settings that disable Host-header validation: ALLOWED_HOSTS = ["*"] in settings.py; a production settings file whose env-var fallback is "*" (so an unset ALLOWED_HOSTS env var yields ['*']); and a staging settings file that appends "*" after the loopback entries, including the IPv6 "[::1]" whose `]` used to end the list match early. VC196 must fire on all three.
